stratagem.name: LAYERED CERAMITE
stratagem.lore: The labours of artisans in the Chapter armoury now bear fruit.
stratagem.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagem.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagem.name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagem.lore: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crews of their vehicles are slain.
stratagem.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units).
stratagem.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s: ▪ M. ▪ BS. ▪ Hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagem.name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
stratagem.lore: Exhaustive tactical training aids Space Marine gunners in exploiting any weakness in their targets’ armour.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units) is selected to shoot.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].
